verdict.rationale: mParticle documents Data Privacy Controls with consent-based forwarding rules per destination (e.g., block forwarding to a partner if CCPA opt-out is present) and a general data transformation layer ('Transform data as it enters and leaves mParticle'), which together enable some per-destination control over sensitive data flow. However, there is no direct documentation shown for field-level hashing, masking, or granular PII filtering of specific attributes per destination — the evidence covers consent gating and generic transformation, not explicit hash/mask controls. Missing for 10: explicit field-level hashing/masking docs, granular attribute-level filtering examples, and independent/hands-on confirmation of these controls in practice.
